clips.prompt: A soldier holding an assault rifle with both hands stands guard at the ready, rifle held low across the body, shifting weight slightly and looking around.
A soldier holding an assault rifle with both hands raises the rifle to the shoulder and scans left and right, ready to fire.
A soldier holding an assault rifle with both hands walks forward in a straight line at a steady patrol pace, rifle held across the chest.
A soldier holding an assault rifle with both hands runs forward in a straight line at a steady pace, rifle held across the chest.
A soldier holding an assault rifle with both hands aims the rifle at the shoulder and fires a burst, the shoulders and arms jolting back with the recoil of each shot.
A soldier is shot in the chest, flinches and staggers back a step, then steadies.
A soldier is shot, staggers, drops to the knees and collapses forward onto the ground, lying still.
A huge heavily armored brute stomps forward slowly in a straight line, shoulders swaying, arms held wide and heavy.
A huge heavily armored brute raises both fists overhead and smashes them down in front of the body.
A huge heavily armored brute stands in place breathing heavily, shoulders rising and falling, arms hanging wide and heavy at the sides, shifting weight slowly.
